searchText: Probably not viable to ban new deployments without something like EthereumObjectFormat (see <#706868829900505180> channel) being live which isn't happening anytime soon. Also probably worth watching the recording of this morning's "State Expiry" call. SELFDESTRUCT is briefly covered towards the end of the call. Not a lot of new information but relevant. Current path that seems most valuable to explore is what happens if we redefine the opcode to be UNCONDITIONAL_SEND (it transfers full ETH balance and does nothing else). What breaks? What possible security holes does this leave us with if the assumption that contract code/nonce/state are cleared is broken.
